summary.text: Mike Beltran is the Republican nominee for Florida's 14th Congressional District. A trial attorney and business owner, he served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2018 to 2024 and chose not to seek re-election in 2024. His campaign website describes him as known in the Florida House as "the Billslayer" and says he is campaigning on the border, taxes, spending, and abortion.

paragraphs.text: Born in New York, New York; graduated from Stuyvesant High School in 2002. In his Ballotpedia survey he says he was an Eagle Scout growing up.
Earned a bachelor's degree in international relations from the University of Pennsylvania in 2005 and a law degree from Harvard Law School in 2008.
Worked as a law clerk to U.S. District Judge Steven D. Merryday and as an associate at Boies, Schiller & Flexner LLP.
Worked as a litigator at his own firm, Beltran Litigation, P.A.; says he moved to Florida seeking economic opportunity and started a business that he still operates.
First ran for the Florida House in 2018 and won the general election for District 57; he was re-elected in 2020.
Won re-election in 2022 in the redrawn District 70, defeating Eleuterio Salazar Jr., and left office in November 2024 without seeking another term.
According to his campaign website, he was known in the Florida House as "the Billslayer" for defeating bills, and he championed school choice there.
Advanced from the August 18, 2026 Republican primary for Florida's 14th Congressional District.
